trade_construction.population_for_win_rate_pf: Trades whose PRIMARY_LONG or PRIMARY_SHORT entry signal is a finalized EXTRA_CANDIDATE
trade_construction.pairing_rule: Pair each PRIMARY_LONG/PRIMARY_SHORT with the next corresponding LONG_EXIT/SHORT_EXIT in the same frozen M7C proxy state-machine stream. Bootstrap positions with no post-start PRIMARY entry are excluded.
trade_construction.extra_exit_actions: Recorded separately and excluded from standalone WR/PF to avoid double-counting the parent trade.
trade_construction.source_matched_suppression: NOT_SILENT; any future suppression requires an explicit separately validated portfolio rule

price_contract.execution_boundary: Exact new-M15 decision boundary represented by current_server_open in frozen proxy decisions.
price_contract.price_source: Exact M1 bar whose MT5 server-time open equals the frozen entry/exit current_server_open.
price_contract.long_entry: M1 bid open + historical spread points * SYMBOL_POINT * spread_multiplier
price_contract.short_exit: M1 bid open + historical spread points * SYMBOL_POINT * spread_multiplier
price_contract.symbol_point_source: MetaTrader5 symbol_info().point captured at audit runtime

cost_contract.interpretation: Spread-adjusted results are exploratory and gross of any broker commission/swap not embedded in the spread. No promotion claim may rely on this sample alone.
